ambiguities.used: step-0 value = G12 bce_declared (the head's BCE on a real batch before any update); the row = the first 'train' event with update >= ceil(0.10 x 400) = 40, i.e. update 50 (a 25-update mean)

ambiguities.alt: N = the mean of the three N seeds; micro-batch 4 timing (not measured at S1)

ambiguities.used: memory: G12 head_retained_gb > 1.0 OR preflight gpu_mem_gb(H) - gpu_mem_gb(N same seed) > 1.0; time: run-mean s_per_update at update 400 AND the median per-window s/update (A7.4), each H vs the same-seed N, > +3 %; any limb fires K3

ambiguities.alt: treat a K5 failure as a fifth promotion condition
